intro.h2: A Chico kitchen shop where you can see it all first
paragraphs: New Again Kitchen Remodeling makes kitchen remodeling in Chico simpler by keeping the choices in one place. The Mangrove Ave showroom has slabs and samples of granite and quartz, full cabinet displays and tile, so you can put a whole kitchen together in an afternoon.

It is a smaller company, and the team says that lets staff really get to know each client and what they need. Customers back that up: one called them easy to communicate with, personable and not pretentious, and said they got a great deal. Google's review summary also quotes a homeowner who noted that they showed up, finished, and the price remained what they were quoted.

items.name: Full kitchen remodels
items.blurb: New cabinets, countertops and backsplash planned together. Recent kitchens include grey beadboard cabinets with a marble-look quartz island and subway tile, and a kitchen with a farmhouse sink, light quartz counters and a linear glass and stone mosaic backsplash.

about.text: New Again Kitchen Remodeling is a kitchen remodeler at 1108 Mangrove Ave in Chico, California. The showroom is set up like a row of finished kitchens, with navy shaker cabinets around a white farmhouse sink, cherry and honey maple displays, and countertop and tile samples. The team describes itself as a smaller company where staff can really get to know clients and their needs, with a new variety of granite and quartz, new cabinet styles and a tile selection. Customers who have worked with them call the team personable, easy to talk to and good value.

They were easy communicate with, personable and not pretentious. They gave us a great deal and our kitchen looks amazing!  I can’t recommend their team enough!

service_area.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Chico and nearby
service_area.text: New Again Kitchen Remodeling works from its showroom at 1108 Mangrove Ave in Chico, California, and installs kitchens for Chico homeowners. Come in to see granite, quartz, cabinets and tile in person, then the team measures and installs at your home. If you live outside Chico and want to know whether New Again can take on your kitchen, call (530) 899-2888.

items.q: Where is your showroom and when is it open?
items.a: The showroom is at 1108 Mangrove Ave, Chico, CA 95926. It is open Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 5 PM and Saturday from 9 AM to 3 PM, and closed Sunday. Saturday hours make it easy to come in and compare materials on a weekend.

items.q: What countertop materials do you carry?
items.a: New Again carries a variety of granite and quartz. Granite variety is one of the topics Google reviewers bring up most, and the stone on hand has included Glacier White, cream granites with gold veining and speckled white granites, so you can compare colours in person.

Yes. The showroom displays several cabinet styles, including navy shaker, cherry and honey maple raised panel, set up as working kitchen runs with sinks and appliances. One customer bought display cabinets and counters from the old showroom and had New Again install the counters.

items.q: Does the price stay what you quote?
items.a: Ask the team to walk you through exactly what your quote covers before work starts. Google's review summary quotes a homeowner saying they showed up, finished, and the price remained what they were quoted, and another reviewer said New Again gave them a great deal on their kitchen.

Call (530) 899-2888, email newagainkitchen@gmail.com or visit the Mangrove Ave showroom. Bring photos and rough measurements of your kitchen if you have them, so the team can help you choose cabinets, granite or quartz and tile and price the installation.

final_cta.text: Visit the Chico showroom on Mangrove Ave or call to talk it through.
